brief.text: Gupta Oil Mills, Kanpur. Diwali offer creative for our kachi ghani sarson ka tel 1 litre tin. Photo of the tin attached, tin ka colour aur label bilkul same rehna chahiye. Price line exactly ₹185 प्रति लीटर likhna hai, ek bhi akshar galat nahi hona chahiye — pichli baar agency ne 185 ko 186 kar diya tha. Square creative for WhatsApp forward. Warm festive feel, diya ya marigold chalega, par tin sabse pehle dikhna chahiye. No people in the picture.
